description: Each middleware runs code before `await next()`, the rest of the chain produces the response, then code after `next()` runs in reverse order.
A unique id per request (`X-Request-Id`) attached to every log line and forwarded to downstream services, so one request can be traced end to end.
Log entries as JSON objects (`{ requestId, path, status, durationMs }`) that log platforms can index and query, instead of free text.
An `OPTIONS` request the browser sends before non-simple cross-origin requests. The server answers with allowed origins, methods and headers.
CORS option listing response headers frontend JavaScript may read (`X-Request-Id`, `X-Total-Count`); others stay hidden from cross-origin code.
Response header with named durations (`db;dur=12`) shown in the DevTools Network panel.
